title: Run in the successor phase
statement: Let $k\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be a finite Boolean word, and let $d$ be a configuration with $k+2$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and successor-phase states. For every natural number $t$, running the record-and-skip machine for $t$ steps from the state-renamed configuration equals running the successor-field machine for $t$ steps from $d$ and then renaming its state.
hypotheses_covered: Configuration d with k+2 tapes and successor-phase states
